messages:
jen-support: Hey team — BrightMed just reported a flurry of 504s + duplicate billing from hosted generate streams around 10:15 PDT. They say the client saw long hangs (~30-45s) then finally got a 200 and were billed twice due to SDK retries. Can we triage?

customer-brightmed: Confirmed. We have logs showing client SDK retried after no data for ~20s. They ended up with two completed responses for one user action. Impacting billing dashboard and a few users.

sam-engineer: Thanks. Can you paste a sample request id and approximate timestamps from your side? Also which SDK version?

customer-brightmed: req=brt-2026-03-17-3321, timestamps around 2026-03-17T17:15:12Z -> 17:15:46Z. SDK: js v1.4.2 using streaming=true.

lee-sdk: That SDK version has a known behavior: it retries on connection timeout if it doesn't see the streaming-complete sentinel. We pushed a change in v1.5 to check for final chunk before retrying, but many clients still on v1.4.2.

marta-sre: Noted. From infra side, I'm seeing a short spike in gateway queueing and increased slow-writes on edge-proxy at 17:15Z in us-west-2. Several upstreams reported long write latencies ~100ms per chunk which accumulated. Could explain perceived hang.

sam-engineer: Can we reproduce? Steps to attempt: 1) single large streaming generate (prompt ~15k tokens) 2) set client window to 20s idle timeout 3) send on js v1.4.2. If gateway stalls, client will retry and possibly cause duplicate completions.

jen-support: I drafted repro steps for the customer to run locally. Want eng to confirm before we ask them to run.

sam-engineer: Confirmed. Also add an idempotency header x-idempotency-key to the request body so server can dedupe, as a short-term mitigation. We'll default to returning 409 on duplicate completed responses.

marta-sre: Short-term infra mitigation: (a) increase edge keepalive timeout from 20s -> 40s for streaming paths, (b) bump proxy write buffer and reduce per-connection simultaneous streams from 8 -> 4 temporarily, (c) emergency autoscale for gateway pool in us-west-2. I'll open a runbook ticket.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: edge-proxy-keepalive-bump -> staging -> canary (id: deploy-2026-03-17-epb1)

lee-sdk: I'll draft a patch to the SDK to be more conservative about retrying streaming connections: check final-frame sentinel and respect server-sent content-length-equivalent header. We can ship patch v1.4.3 today as hotfix.

sam-engineer: For long-term: we should implement server-side streaming idempotency (request-id + final-sentinel) and update docs. Also add a billing safety net: detect duplicated completions within 2 minutes for same idempotency key and refund/ignore second charge.

jen-support: Customer comms draft: "We're sorry — we identified edge proxy slow-writes causing streaming clients to hang and retry. We are implementing a hotfix for the SDK and a short infra config change. We will proactively reconcile duplicate charges for affected requests and follow up with a credit. ETA for full fix: 48 hours." Thoughts?

marta-sre: Sounds good. I'll include a link to the incident ticket and the temporary mitigation steps.

sam-engineer: Quick log snippets for debugging: ```
edge-proxy/usw2 write-slow: conn=abcd1234 delay=105ms chunks=12 
gateway/generate svc: req=brt-2026-03-17-3321 state=streaming idle=21s retry_count=0 
backend/model-run: finished tokens=2340 duration=28s status=ok 
client-js: saw no data for 20s -> triggered retry -> new req succeeded at 17:15:46Z
```

lee-sdk: For the hotfix I'll add a conservative retry threshold and ensure the SDK emits a unique x-idempotency-key by default for streaming clients.

jen-support: Action items: 1) Marta: apply keepalive + proxy settings (in progress) 2) Sam: add server-side idempotency plan + billing dedupe proposal 3) Lee: ship SDK 1.4.3 hotfix 4) Jen: send customer comms after we confirm mitigations.

customer-brightmed: Appreciate the quick responses. We'll turn on x-idempotency-key and test with your repro steps once you confirm. Please keep us posted.

sam-engineer: I'll own the postmortem and timeline. Tentative: hotfix + infra tweak in 4 hours, billing reconciliation within 24 hours, full server-side dedupe in next sprint.

jen-support: Sending customer an interim note now. "Interim update: we have identified an edge proxy slow-write spike that can cause streaming clients to hang and retry; mitigations are being deployed now. We recommend enabling x-idempotency-key on your calls and updating to SDK v1.4.3 when available."

marta-sre: Mitigations deployed to canary. Monitoring for error-rate drop.

deploy-bot: canary deploy complete: edge-proxy-keepalive-bump (canary id: canary-epb1)

sam-engineer: Monitoring shows p50 streaming latency unchanged, p99 down from 18s -> 3.2s for canary traffic. Looks promising.

jen-support: Thanks everyone, will update BrightMed in 30 minutes with confirmed results and next steps.
